messages:
Sarah (CS): Heads-up: Northpoint Labs renewal hits this Friday. Two separate legal entities — NP US will submit a PO, NP EU wants to pay by card. Procurement asked for split invoicing and a single SOW that references both invoices. Putting thread here to coordinate signatures/payment methods and any legal/billing blockers.

Ben (AE): Client reconfirmed seats and prefers a 9‑month term (not 12). They'll sign if we can do split billing. Can we do PO for US entity + CC for EU under the same SOW?

Morgan (RevOps): We can support two invoices tied to two billing entities, but note: our billing system requires separate invoices per payment method. That means one SOW referencing both invoices (ok), but two invoice numbers. I need vendor code (if PO), billing contact, exact line items and tax/VAT handling.

OpsBot: billing ticket BILL-4821 created for invoice split and PO intake.

Liam - Legal: Delegated-signature requests are acceptable but we need an "authorized signatory declaration" from the customer showing authority. Also, deviating to 9 months is fine but we should capture it as an addendum rather than changing the MSA. I'll review the addendum once drafted.

Sarah (CS): Client said NP US can provide PO today; NP EU will provide CC by EOD Friday. Can CS collect billing contact info and the authorized-signer doc? The client also asked for VAT language on the EU invoice.

Ben (AE): I'll grab PO and billing contact now. Quick note — EU asked to opt out of auto-renewal on their invoice. Is that a dealbreaker?

Morgan (RevOps): Not a blocker. We can flag the EU invoice as "no automatic renewal" via an addendum clause and store that in the billing record. Please send PO to billing@redwood.com with PO# + billing entity exactly as it should appear on the invoice. I'll generate two invoices after I have PO and CC holder info.

Sarah (CS): Noted. If they can provide the authorized signatory doc for the delegated signer that will speed things up. Otherwise legal sign-off may add ~1 business day.

Ben (AE): PO received in DM, sending to billing now. Client says CFO (Pete Marshall) will sign for US. EU will provide card details via secure form.

Sarah (CS): Uploading redacted PO snippet here for reference:

-----BEGIN PO-----
PO#: NP-2026-091
Entity: Northpoint Labs US, Inc.
Amount: $120,000
Billing contact: pete@northpointlabs.com
-----END PO-----

EU payment: card ending 4242, will supply billing email and VAT number.

OpsBot: billing ticket BILL-4821 updated; PO attached; assigned to Morgan (RevOps).

Morgan (RevOps): Got the PO. I'll create INV-78921 for NP US and prepare INV-78922 for NP EU (card). I need the final SOW addendum text for: 1) term = 9 months, 2) billing split + invoice numbers, 3) EU invoice "no auto-renewal", 4) VAT handling, and 5) inclusion of "authorized signatory declaration". Sarah, can you draft the addendum?

Sarah (CS): Drafting now — proposed short addendum below:

Addendum (draft):
- Term: nine (9) months from effective date.
- Billing: Services invoiced per billing entity; NP US invoice (INV-78921) payable via PO; NP EU invoice (INV-78922) payable via credit card.
- Renewal: NP EU invoice explicitly excluded from automatic renewal; renewal requires mutual written agreement.
- Taxes: Customer responsible for VAT where applicable; EU invoice will include VAT as reported by customer.
- Authorized Signatory Declaration: Customer will provide declaration or corporate resolution authorizing the signatory for NP US.

Any objections?

Liam - Legal: Minor wording tweaks: replace "authorized signatory declaration" with "authorized signatory declaration or corporate resolution", and add "execution by counterpart signatures is acceptable". With those edits legal approves the addendum.

Morgan (RevOps): Perfect. I'll apply the wording, issue the two invoices and attach the addendum. Target: invoices out in ~90 minutes, then we send two e‑sign requests (one per signatory/entity).

Ben (AE): :thumbsup: I'll notify the customer and push for immediate signature. If EU CC authorization fails, plan B is card-on-file fallback and coordination with finance for reconciliation.

Sarah (CS): Marking this low risk now. Will monitor signbacks and payment confirmations and report status here. Thanks team!
